# Deaver Electric Inc.

> > Family-owned electrical contractor serving Des Moines and Grimes, Iowa with residential and commercial electrical services, safety inspections, and code-compliant installations.

Deaver Electric Inc. is a local Iowa electrical contractor specializing in panel upgrades, fire hazard prevention, NEC-compliant wiring, and both residential and commercial electrical services. Their blog provides practical electrical safety guidance, troubleshooting tips, and educational content for homeowners and businesses in the Des Moines metro area.

- [Is Your Electrical Panel a Hazard? (EN)](https://www.deaverelectricinc.com/en/blog/is-your-electrical-panel-a-hazard): Panel upgrade guide identifying hazardous FPE and Stab-Lok breakers
